s01.t7: We're building one website where women in Barbados can shop local small businesses, most of them women-owned, from beauty and fashion to jewellery, home, gifts and digital products. We'd love your business to be in it.

s02.t11: One website. Every Bajan small business.
s02.t12: She's getting ready for a fete, a wedding, or just a soft life weekend. Right now she hops between ten Instagram pages, waits on DMs and drives across the island to find what she needs.
s02.t13: On Shop Bajan she opens one site, finds trusted Bajan small businesses side by side, checks out once and gets it all delivered together. Your products, your name and your story are right there when she's ready to buy.

s07.t99: Is there anything I can't sell?
s07.t100: Yes: We don't sell food, liquor, wine or other alcohol. Everything else that is legal, genuine and made or chosen for Bajan shoppers is welcome.
s07.t102: You do. You set every price in BBD, and we never discount your products without your OK.
s07.t103: Can I still sell on my own page and in my shop?
s07.t104: Yes. Keep selling everywhere you do now. We only ask that you don't advertise the same product for less than its Shop Bajan price.
s07.t105: How and when do I get paid?
s07.t106: Every Sunday, for everything sold the week before, by bank transfer, FirstPay or BPWCCUL, with a statement of each sale.
s07.t108: Each batch stays with us for 60 days. Then you can renew it, swap it for new stock, or collect it. Your products stay yours until they sell.
s07.t109: What exactly does Shop Bajan do for me?
s07.t110: Think of us as your shop on the Bajan Amazon. You get your own shop page on our website with your logo, story and products. You drop off your stock with us in St. Thomas (or add a download link for digital products) and we keep it safe. When someone orders, we take the payment, pack the order, deliver it or arrange collection, and handle any questions or returns. Every Sunday we send you your share of the week before, and you can see every sale in your Vendor Portal. You set your own prices and keep selling everywhere you already do. On a $50 sale you keep $42.50 in your first year.
s07.t111: What about returns and damaged items?
s07.t112: We handle customer questions and returns. If an item is faulty because of the product, it comes back to you and the refund comes out of your next payout. If we damage something, we pay you for it.
s07.t114: Starter is perfect to try us out. Every plan has the same per-sale fee, so Spotlight and Signature are for when you want your business seen by more shoppers: homepage spots, shout-outs, posts and Reels.
s07.t115: How does the free month work?
s07.t116: Your first month on any paid plan is free. When you join, you set up your monthly plan payment by card through PayPal's secure page, but nothing is charged until your second month starts. Change or cancel your plan anytime before then.
s07.t117: What is the per-sale fee for?
s07.t118: It covers card fees, checkout, order handling and customer care, so you never have to deal with them. Starter needs no card and has no monthly fee. It's 15% of each sale for your first 12 months with us, then 20%. We'll remind you at least 30 days before it changes.
s07.t120: Yes. Upgrade, downgrade or switch anytime. The new plan starts from your next monthly payment.
s07.t121: What do I need to sign up?
s07.t122: An email address and your phone. You create a free vendor login, add your business details, plan and how you'd like to be paid, sign the agreement, then upload your own product photos and prices in your Vendor Portal. On a paid plan you'll also need a debit or credit card for PayPal (charged from month two).
s07.t123: Can I update my products myself?
s07.t124: Yes. In your Vendor Portal you can add products and photos, change prices and stock, and hide items anytime. New products and changes go live once we approve them, normally within 2 working days. Stock changes update straight away.
s07.t126: Yes, a short consignment agreement you read and sign online when you create your vendor account. Either of us can end it with 14 days' notice.
